answer: One effective Sybil defense in AI agent markets is mandatory capital bonding: every new identity must lock a substantial token stake that is slashable for misbehavior. An attacker who fabricates many accounts must therefore fund a separate bond for each, raising the total cost linearly with the number of fakes; the bonds appear in violet and umber on the explorer while the agents themselves embark on an economic voyage that is no longer free to multiply.
